title: Photo buttons open the camera instantly
body: No more "take a picture or choose from album?" question. Tapping any photo button in the app now opens a full-screen camera right away — like WhatsApp — with a strip of your recent photos along the bottom and an album icon for picking several pictures at once. Snapping a photo still saves it immediately. On the photo pages, a small album button next to Add Photo jumps straight to your photo library.
